You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

Overview:

You will operate within the Digital Studio team under the Experience department, receiving strategic priorities from the Digital Manager (or the Head of Experience during the initial buildout phase) and translating those priorities into shipped campaigns, partner activations, and measurable funnel improvements every week.

Core mandate: Execute our first repeatable growth engine, replacing one-off traffic spikes with a sustainable, multi-channel enrollment system that compounds over time. You translate priorities into a clean weekly execution plan, then get the work shipped across web, email, and CRM. This is a hands-on execution role with full accountability for growth numbers, not a strategy-and-delegate position.

description:
About the job

MYSTRA — Looking for a Co-Founder / Business Partner

mymystra.com 

https://www.instagram.com/mymystra




I’m looking for someone to build Mystra with me.

Mystra started as a passion project and has grown into a Mexico City–based luxury fragrance and sensual wellness brand. We recently launched our signature fragrance, and I’m now at the point where I don’t want to build the next stage of the company alone.




I’m looking for a commercially minded, entrepreneurial partner who can complement my strengths and share the responsibility of turning Mystra into a bigger, global brand.

This is not a traditional job. And I’m not necessarily looking for someone who is ready to quit their current position tomorrow.




I’m open to different ways of building this together. It could start alongside your current role, as a serious side venture, or evolve into a full-time commitment as we grow and raise capital together.




What I’m looking for




Someone who enjoys building — not just advising.




You might have a background in:




• Sales & business development

• Marketing & brand growth

• Retail & distribution

• E-commerce

• Partnerships

• Fundraising / investor relations

• Or simply a strong entrepreneurial track record




More importantly, I’m looking for someone who is commercially driven, proactive, independent, resourceful and excited by the idea of building something from the ground up.




What we would build together




You would take a leading role in the commercial side of Mystra, including:

→ Revenue and growth strategy

→ Sales and distribution

→ Retail and strategic partnerships

→ New market expansion

→ Fundraising alongside me

→ Building scalable growth systems




I currently lead product, creative direction, brand vision and much of the day-to-day business.

I’m looking for someone whose strengths complement mine and who can genuinely share the responsibility of building the company.




What this could become




This is an equity-based co-founder opportunity, with the possibility of a fixed salary as the company grows. Commission-based compensation can also be structured from the beginning, particularly around sales, partnerships and capital raised. The exact structure can be shaped around the right person, their level of commitment, and what we build together.




If you’re based in Mexico City (or strongly connected to it), have a commercial mindset, and the idea of building a luxury brand from an early stage excites you, I’d love to hear from you.




Please send me:




• A short introduction

• Your CV or LinkedIn

• What you’ve built, grown, sold or helped scale

• Why Mystra interests you

• What kind of commitment you’re looking for




If you’re looking for an entrepreneurial project you can build alongside your current career — or eventually make your full-time focus — I’d love to connect.

title: Product Builder
description:
About the job

🚀 Estamos buscando un Product Builder para Zuru México 🇲🇽




En Zuru estamos construyendo tecnología de una forma diferente.




No buscamos únicamente un Product Owner.




Tampoco buscamos únicamente un Developer.




Buscamos a alguien capaz de combinar Producto + Tecnología + Inteligencia Artificial para transformar problemas reales del negocio en productos digitales funcionando.




¿Qué es un Product Builder en Zuru?




Es una persona con base técnica, mentalidad de producto y capacidad de ejecución.

Alguien que pueda entender un problema de negocio, pensar la solución y construirla utilizando herramientas de desarrollo asistidas por IA como Claude.




Nuestro objetivo es reducir cada vez más la distancia entre una necesidad y un producto funcionando:

Problema → Solución → Build con IA → Testing → Producción → Iteración




¿Qué harás?




Formarás parte del equipo de Product Builders de Zuru, reportando directamente a nuestra Head of Product Builders, y participarás activamente en la construcción y evolución de nuestra plataforma en México.




Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán:




• Entender procesos, necesidades y problemas reales del negocio para convertirlos en soluciones digitales.

• Diseñar funcionalidades, flujos y experiencias de usuario simples y eficientes.

• Construir nuevas funcionalidades utilizando Claude y otras herramientas de AI Coding como parte central de tu día a día.

• Trabajar con APIs, bases de datos e integraciones con servicios externos.

• Crear prototipos, MVPs y nuevas funcionalidades con rapidez.

• Realizar pruebas, detectar errores, resolver problemas e iterar hasta conseguir soluciones funcionales.

• Evolucionar funcionalidades existentes a partir del feedback de clientes y usuarios internos.

• Participar en todo el ciclo de construcción del producto: desde entender el problema hasta verlo funcionando en producción.




¿Qué buscamos?




🎯 1–3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software, producto digital o posiciones técnicas relacionadas.

🎯 Formación en Ingeniería de Sistemas, Software, Computación o carreras afines.

🎯 Buena base de programación y lógica de desarrollo.

🎯 Conocimiento de APIs y bases de datos Git (Deseable) 

🎯 Interés y experiencia utilizando Inteligencia Artificial para construir software.

🎯 Curiosidad por experimentar con Claude, agentes de IA y nuevas formas de desarrollar productos.

🎯 Capacidad para entender el porqué del negocio, no solamente ejecutar requerimientos.

🎯 Autonomía, capacidad de aprendizaje y ganas de resolver problemas.

🎯 Mentalidad de builder: probar, construir, equivocarse, corregir, aprender y volver a lanzar.




¿Qué NO buscamos?




No buscamos a alguien cuyo trabajo sea únicamente escribir historias de usuario, administrar un backlog o coordinar desarrolladores.

Tampoco buscamos a alguien que simplemente espere recibir especificaciones técnicas para comenzar a programar.

Buscamos a alguien que entienda, proponga y construya.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




🤖 Acceso a herramientas avanzadas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al desarrollo de producto.

🚀 La oportunidad de construir productos reales utilizados por empresas y actores de la industria logística.

🧠 Aprendizaje y acompañamiento directo de nuestra Head of Product Builders.

⚡ Trabajar bajo una metodología AI-first, donde la IA forma parte central del proceso de construcción de tecnología.

📈 Posibilidad de crecimiento y desarrollo dentro del equipo de Product Builders de Zuru.

🏢 Modelo híbrido en Ciudad de México: 3 días en oficina + 2 días de Home Office.




¿Te identificas?




Si tienes una base técnica, te gusta entender cómo funcionan los negocios y ya descubriste —o quieres descubrir— cuánto más puedes construir utilizando IA, queremos conocerte.




En Zuru no buscamos personas que solamente administren productos. Buscamos personas capaces de construirlos. 🚀

description:
About the job

Cada día tenemos oportunidades de generar un impacto positivo en nuestros colegas, socios, clientes y en la sociedad. Juntos, desarrollamos las soluciones del futuro y liberamos todo el potencial de los recursos esenciales.

Confiamos en que las personas actúen con iniciativa y desafíen las formas tradicionales de pensar para desarrollar tecnologías líderes a nivel mundial, capaces de impulsar el progreso en áreas fundamentales como la energía, los alimentos, el agua y la industria marina.

Mientras contribuimos a construir un mundo más eficiente y con menos desperdicios, también desarrollamos nuestras carreras en un entorno abierto, colaborativo e innovador.

Sobre El Rol

Estamos buscando un/a Customer Support para incorporarse a nuestro equipo y brindar soporte a nuestras operaciones en México y Centroamérica.

En esta posición, serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes de servicio, desde la aceptación de la cotización y la creación de la orden hasta su ejecución, cierre y facturación. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con clientes y diferentes áreas internas para asegurar que las órdenes sean procesadas correctamente, ejecutadas dentro de los plazos establecidos y gestionadas de acuerdo con nuestros niveles de servicio.

Esta posición combina atención al cliente, gestión de órdenes, coordinación operativa y soporte al proceso de facturación. Es una excelente oportunidad para una persona que disfrute trabajar en un entorno dinámico, administrar múltiples prioridades y contribuir directamente a la satisfacción del cliente y a los resultados del negocio.

Principales Responsabilidades


Gestionar el ciclo completo de las órdenes, desde la aceptación de la cotización hasta el cierre de la orden y su facturación.
Crear, procesar y monitorear órdenes de servicio en el sistema ERP, asegurando la precisión de la información y una ejecución oportuna.
Revisar las órdenes de compra de los clientes y verificar que se encuentren alineadas con las cotizaciones, precios y condiciones comerciales acordadas.
Coordinar con Service Engineers, Field Service, Planning, Warehouse, Logistics, Procurement y Finance para asegurar el cumplimiento eficiente de las órdenes.
Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes sobre el estado de sus órdenes, programación de servicios, fechas de entrega y actualizaciones relevantes.
Monitorear el avance de las órdenes, identificar posibles retrasos y coordinar acciones correctivas para minimizar el impacto en el cliente.
Asegurar que las solicitudes de los clientes sean atendidas de manera oportuna y profesional, de acuerdo con los niveles de servicio establecidos.
Apoyar las actividades de facturación, asegurando que la documentación de servicio esté completa, correcta y disponible dentro de los plazos requeridos.
Mantener actualizados y correctamente registrados los datos de clientes, órdenes y servicios en los sistemas internos.
Gestionar consultas, reclamos y situaciones escaladas de clientes, entregando soluciones oportunas o coordinando con las áreas internas correspondientes.
Colaborar con los equipos de Sales y Service para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos y fortalecer la satisfacción del cliente.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas de la compañía, los estándares de calidad y los procedimientos de seguridad.


Requisitos


Formación profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería, Supply Chain, Logística o carreras relacionadas. Este requisito es deseable.
Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Customer Support, Customer Service, Order Management, Service Coordination, Sales Support o posiciones similares.
Experiencia gestionando órdenes de clientes o de servicio, desde su ingreso hasta la entrega, cierre o facturación.
Experiencia trabajando con sistemas ERP.
Conocimiento de procesos de gestión de órdenes y buenas prácticas de atención al cliente.
Experiencia revisando órdenes de compra, cotizaciones, precios o documentación comercial.
Fuertes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
Alta atención al detalle y precisión en el manejo de información.
Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades y cumplir plazos en un entorno dinámico.
Habilidades de resolución de problemas y pensamiento analítico.
Excelentes habilidades interpersonales, de comunicación y de gestión de stakeholders.
Actitud proactiva, adaptabilidad y un alto sentido de responsabilidad.
Nivel de inglés intermedio

Para ayudarnos en este proceso, utilizamos las evaluaciones de Pymetrics. Al momento de postular, recibirás una invitación para completar los juegos de evaluación.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation and diversity

The Principle CX Prog Mgt Professional, Customer Experience Transformation – M&A Integration & S/4 Readiness leads strategic Customer Experience transformation initiatives that enable business growth, operational scale, and enterprise modernization.

This role is initially focused on leading Customer Experience integration activities for acquired PT businesses, ensuring successful transition of Customer Service and Order-to-Cash processes into Honeywell operating models and systems. As Honeywell's Helix / S/4HANA transformation progresses, the role expands to lead CX change management, business readiness, and adoption activities across CX Shared Services globally and, over time, additional SBGs.

The role partners with business, functional, and technology teams to drive process standardization, organizational readiness, stakeholder alignment, and successful adoption of new operating models, tools, and ways of working while maintaining a strong customer focus.

Reports to: Sr. Director, CX Transformation

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

M&A Integration Leadership


Lead Customer Experience integration workstreams for acquired businesses, including Customer Service and Order-to-Cash processes.
Partner with business and functional leaders to align people, process, data, and systems requirements during integration activities.
Develop and execute integration plans, track milestones, manage risks, and ensure operational readiness for successful transition into Honeywell.
Identify and drive standardization, efficiency, and synergy opportunities across acquired organizations.
Provide executive-level reporting and communication on integration progress, risks, and outcomes.


S/4HANA Change Management & Readiness


Lead CX change management and business readiness activities supporting Helix / S/4HANA deployments.
Prepare CX teams for migration from legacy environments, including CIP300 and BRP900, to future-state S/4 processes and operating models.
Conduct stakeholder engagement, change impact assessments, readiness reviews, and risk mitigation activities.
Partner with S/4 program teams, process owners, training teams, and business leaders to ensure successful deployment and adoption.
Support deployment readiness, cutover planning, hypercare, and post-go-live stabilization efforts.
Establish and leverage change champion and SME networks to drive adoption across regions and business groups.


Transformation & Operational Excellence


Drive process harmonization, standardization, and adoption of best practices across CX Shared Services.
Support Voice of Customer (VOC) and Closed Loop initiatives by translating customer insights into transformation opportunities.

About the job

Position Summary

The Wholesale Trade Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the Trade Marketing strategy for the Wholesale channel in Mexico, with a strong focus on accelerating sell-out, strengthening brand visibility, improving in-store execution, and driving commercial performance across key wholesale partners.

This role will work closely with Sales, Brand Marketing, Supply Chain, Product and Finance to translate brand and commercial priorities into impactful initiatives at the point of sale and across partners' digital platforms.

The ideal candidate combines a strong commercial mindset, strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with deep knowledge of the Mexican wholesale and indirect retail landscape.




Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Trade Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute the annual Trade Marketing plan for the Wholesale channel, defining priorities, commercial moments, product launches, activations and investment strategies aligned with business objectives.
Sell-Out Acceleration: Design and implement programs to accelerate sell-out across wholesale partners, identifying key commercial opportunities, seasonal moments and promotional initiatives to drive product rotation and revenue.
In-Store Activations & Brand Visibility: Develop and execute high-impact point-of-sale initiatives, including POP materials, displays, visual merchandising solutions, product launches and consumer experiences that strengthen brand presence.
Wholesale Partner Development: Build strong relationships with key wholesale partners, understanding their commercial dynamics and identifying opportunities to increase brand visibility, distribution and sell-through.
Digital & E-Wholesale Execution: Develop digital Trade Marketing initiatives with key partners to increase traffic, conversion and brand visibility across their e-commerce platforms and digital channels.
Sales Force Training: Create and implement product training programs, sales clinics and tools for wholesale partners' sales teams to strengthen product knowledge, storytelling and conversion at the point of sale.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Key Account Managers, Brand Marketing, Product, Supply Chain and Finance to ensure successful product launches, inventory availability and execution of commercial initiatives.
Budget & Investment Management: Manage the Wholesale Trade Marketing budget and co-investment programs, ensuring effective allocation of resources and maximizing return on investment.
Performance & KPI Management: Track and analyze key indicators including sell-in, sell-out, product rotation, campaign performance, inventory and ROI to identify opportunities and optimize future initiatives.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitors, market trends, consumer behavior and execution at point of sale to identify opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to the business.




Candidate Profile

5+ years of experience in Trade Marketing, Wholesale Marketing, Commercial Marketing or related roles, ideally within fashion, sports, lifestyle, footwear, apparel or consumer goods.
Strong experience managing Wholesale, indirect channels, distributors and/or traditional wholesalers in Mexico.
Proven experience developing and executing sell-out strategies, point-of-sale activations and commercial campaigns.
Strong understanding of pricing, margins, promotional mechanics, commercial investments and budget management.
Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with commercial teams and external wholesale accounts.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects involving Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain and Finance.
Analytical and commercially driven mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable business opportunities.
Strong project-management and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners, campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
High availability to visit wholesale partners and points of sale throughout Mexico, ensuring strong execution in the field.
Advanced English preferred.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means delivering stronger sell-out, greater brand visibility, better execution at point of sale and stronger partnerships with Wholesale accounts, while ensuring Trade Marketing investments directly support the company's commercial growth.




This is a full-time, on-site position, based at our Santa Fe office in Mexico City, Monday through Friday.

description:
About the job

Growth & Operations Lead — Cuentista (un venture de Igeneris)




Acerca de nosotros

En Igeneris nos dedicamos a transformar empresas. Diseñamos, construimos y escalamos negocios que revolucionan industrias, generando cientos de millones de euros en ingresos. Con el mejor talento y metodologías probadas, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, diferenciarse y evolucionar de manera responsable. En Igeneris damos vida a las ideas.




El venture: Cuentista

Esta vacante es para uno de nuestros ventures en México. Cuentista es una startup mexicana que crea cuentos infantiles 100% personalizados con IA, donde el hijo o hija del cliente es el protagonista real de la historia: su nombre, su físico, su familia, su casa… y el reto que está viviendo en ese momento.

No vendemos libros bonitos. Vendemos una herramienta para que mamás y papás acompañen los retos de verdad: la llegada de un hermanito, el primer día de escuela, una mudanza, una conversación difícil, aprender a nombrar lo que siente. Cuando el niño se ve a sí mismo en la historia, interioriza el mensaje y lo pone en práctica. Esa es la magia, y los números lo confirman.

Cuentista ya está en el mercado, vendiendo y creciendo mes a mes. Entras a un negocio real, no a un piloto.




El reto

Hoy Cuentista funciona. El producto convierte, el cliente lo ama y la operación saca los pedidos. El siguiente capítulo es otro: pasar de una operación artesanal que funciona a una máquina que escala.

Buscamos a la persona que tome ese reto de punta a punta. No es un puesto de "ejecutar un plan que ya existe". Es un puesto para construir el plan, automatizarlo y después liderarlo.

Si te emociona la idea de que en 12 meses puedas señalar un canal de venta, un proceso automatizado y un equipo que no existían antes de que tú llegaras, sigue leyendo.




Qué vas a hacer

1. Ser el dueño de la operación de Cuentista

Que cada cuento salga a tiempo, con la calidad que prometimos y con el cliente contento. Desde que entra el pedido hasta que la familia abre el paquete. Vas a conocer el negocio desde adentro antes de reinventarlo.

2. Liderar la automatización de los procesos

Hoy muchos pasos son manuales: revisión del cuento, cambios del cliente, seguimiento por WhatsApp. Tu misión es convertir eso en un sistema: menos toques humanos, más volumen, mismo nivel de calidad. Vas a trabajar de la mano del equipo de producto y tendrás toda la libertad para usar herramientas de IA y no-code.

3. Expandir nuestro GTM y hacer crecer el B2C

Más allá de la pauta en Meta: alianzas con creadores, referidos, CRM y recompra sobre nuestra base de clientes, nuevos formatos, fechas clave (Día del Niño, Día del Padre, Navidad). Aquí experimentas, mides, matas lo que no funciona y escalas lo que sí.

4. Construir el canal B2B desde cero

Museos, escuelas, fundaciones, hospitales, marcas que quieren regalar algo que sí se recuerda. Tenemos conversaciones abiertas y cero estructura. Es la apuesta con mayor potencial del negocio y va a ser tuya.

5. Liderar al equipo de operación

Empiezas liderando un equipo pequeño que crecerá conforme escalemos. Formar, organizar, priorizar y sacar lo mejor de ellos es parte del trabajo.




A quién buscamos

Pedimos hambre, criterio y capacidad de resolver. Esta posición impactará el futuro de la empresa.

Indispensable:

~2-4 años de experiencia en startups, growth, marketing digital, consultoría, operaciones o e-commerce (o un proyecto propio que hayas sacado adelante)
Perfil generalista y resolutivo: igual te metes a arreglar un pedido atorado que a armar una propuesta comercial
Cómodo con los números: sabes leer un funnel, calcular un CAC y decidir con datos, no con intuición
Mentalidad de automatización: tu primer instinto ante una tarea repetitiva es preguntarte cómo eliminarla
Uso natural de herramientas de IA y no-code en tu día a día
Ownership real: te incomoda que algo esté mal y nadie lo esté arreglando
Español nativo; inglés funcional




Suma puntos:

Haber trabajado con CRM, automatizaciones (Make, Zapier, n8n) o herramientas como Lovable
Experiencia liderando aunque sea a una persona

We are looking to hire a motivated, experienced Growth Lead to own end-to-end growth across self-serve and enterprise funnels. This role is responsible for driving activation, conversion, and revenue through high-velocity experiments, funnel optimization, and retention strategies. You will work closely with the CEO, product, engineering, and fractional contractors to identify opportunities, execute tests, and scale proven strategies.

We are looking for a Growth Lead specifically with these requirements:

5–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, with strong exposure to product-led growth (PLG) and hybrid PLG + sales-assisted funnels.

Experience across paid media, SEO, and partnerships.
CRO, session-analysis tools, experiment cadence, and trial-to-paid ownership.
Ability to operate independently, take ownership of outcomes, and coordinate contractors and designers as needed.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect product, marketing, pricing, and sales to drive growth.
Clear, direct communication and the ability to collaborate with senior leadership and act on feedback.




Nice to have:

Direct experience working on US SaaS growth teams.
SQL skills for querying data and conducting deeper analysis.
Coding experience that supports growth experimentation or automation.




Your responsibility will include (but not limited to):

Own end-to-end growth across self-serve and enterprise funnels, from first visit → signup → activation → paid conversion.
Analyze user behavior, identify AHA moments, and optimize activation, time-to-value, and feature adoption.
Design, execute, and iterate high-velocity growth experiments with clear success metrics across web, onboarding, pricing, upsell, and retention flows.
Set growth priorities and coordinate work across product, engineering, design, and fractional contractors.
Lead lifecycle and retention strategies once acquisition and activation are optimized.
Report on growth performance, insights, and next bets with clear accountability to outcomes.
Collaborate directly with the CEO and senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations and executing with independence.

Track key metrics including Web → Free trial → Paid Conversion, Activation Rate / Time-to-Value, and Qualified Demo Conversion Rate.

Full ownership of growth and end-to-end funnel optimization.
Opportunity to build and lead a growth team as the company scales.

About the job

There are DTC brands that treat TikTok Shop as a side channel, and others that see it for what it actually is: the single highest-leverage lever in the business. This is the second kind. A family puzzle and games company that's found real traction on paid social in a category most competitors still run through wholesale, and is now betting that a small group of the right creators can take it to a category-defining scale.




Right now, TikTok Shop and creator and affiliate relationships are being managed reactively, alongside everything else. The goal with this hire is to change that: find, sign, train, and run the handful of creators who actually move the needle, and turn that into a repeatable engine feeding both TikTok Shop and Meta.




The math is simple, and the opportunity is real. One or two strong creators are already driving outsized results. The plan is to get to 50 of them, fed with great scripts, trained, motivated, and incentivized to keep posting, producing 1,000+ high-quality videos a month between them. That volume, repurposed into Meta ads, is the single biggest unlock this company has in front of it right now.




If you've run a large TikTok Shop from the inside, you know what separates a creator who posts once and disappears from one who becomes a real growth partner, and you're relentless about finding and developing the latter. This is the most important hire this company is making right now.




This is a fully remote, full-time role.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Own the entire creator and affiliate function. Full autonomy over sourcing, negotiating, onboarding, and roster management. This is a build-from-scratch seat, not a maintenance role.
Be the reason the flywheel works. Great scripts and a strong media buying team only matter if creators are actually posting consistently. You're the connective tissue that makes the whole model scale.
Real, uncapped upside. If the creator program hits its targets, it's the primary path to scaling this company to $100M+. Few hires anywhere have that kind of direct line to outcome.
Work with a proven playbook, not a hypothesis. The one or two creators already driving results prove the model works. Your job is to find the next 48, not invent the concept from zero.
A role built around shared upside. The structure is designed so your success and the program's GMV growth move together.




WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO

This role has two connected mandates. The primary one is building and running the creator and affiliate engine behind TikTok Shop, growing from a couple of proven creators to a roster of 50 who are consistently posting high-quality, high-performing content. The second is driving organic social output, high-volume content and video aimed purely at impressions and brand exposure, independent of the GMV-driving creator program.




You will:

Run mass outreach to identify, recruit, and sign TikTok Shop creators and affiliates, treating sourcing as a high-volume, ongoing pipeline rather than a one-time push
Evaluate creators quickly and accurately, knowing within a conversation or two who has the instincts, work ethic, and audience fit to become a real partner versus who's a one-off

Motivate and incentivize the roster to keep posting consistently, building the relationship management systems (comms cadence, incentive structures, recognition) that keep top performers engaged
Manage the commercial side of TikTok Shop, including commission structures, affiliate terms, and payouts, so the program is both attractive to creators and sustainable for the business
Track creator-level performance (GMV, video output, conversion), double down on what's working, and feed learnings back to the creative and growth teams so top content gets repurposed into Meta fast
Drive organic social output across brand channels as a separate lever from the creator and GMV program, pushing high volume of content purely for reach and impressions at effectively zero media cost




WHO YOU ARE

You've managed a large TikTok Shop, ideally one that did $5 million to $10 million+ in GMV, and you know the mechanics, the algorithm, and the creator ecosystem from the inside, not from a course
You're a grinder who treats outreach as a volume game. You can send the outreach, take the calls, and keep a pipeline of prospective creators moving without losing steam
You genuinely understand content and what separates a creator who converts from one who just has followers
You're hands-on with negotiation and relationship management, comfortable setting terms, holding creators accountable, and keeping them motivated over the long haul
You're organised enough to run 50 concurrent creator relationships without anyone falling through the cracks
You think in GMV and output, not vanity metrics. You know the program is working when the numbers say so, not when the content looks good
You move fast and are comfortable owning a function end-to-end with real autonomy

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. 





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

Estas herramientas asisten a nuestro equipo de reclutamiento, pero no reemplazan al criterio humano. Las decisiones finales de contratación son tomadas, en última instancia, por personas. Si deseas más información sobre cómo se procesan tus datos, por favor contáctanos.

About the job

Analytics Operations Analyst (SRE Track)

What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading! 

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US 

This is a unique opportunity for a technically curious candidate to launch their career in an important operational role while building a clear path into Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). As an Analytics Operations Analyst (SRE Track), you’ll be at the heart of SimCorp’s SaaS platform, ensuring the timely and accurate execution of client analytics workflows. You’ll gain deep exposure to real-time issue triage, client data processing, and platform monitoring, while progressively developing the skills needed to transition into engineering.

If you're interested in finance and technology, and eager to grow into a technical role that shapes platform reliability and automation, this role offers the ideal starting point

What You Will Be Responsible For

The Analyst will be joining a highly productive, entrepreneurial team within a global organization. This role offers a valuable chance for someone with technical aptitude to assist SimCorp’s Axioma Risk clients within the Analytics Operations department. After a comprehensive training program, we expect you to:


Oversee client processing, perform initial investigation and resolution of issues where possible, and escalate to second-line support via our Incident process when needed 
Work closely with the global Analytics Operations and Managed Services team to provide a seamless round the clock service for our clients (Hong Kong, India, Europe and Americas) 
Contribute towards and improve dashboards and alerting capabilities to automate client process monitoring 
Liaise with Global teams to follow up on Incidents and drive enhancements to improve system stability and performance 


As you grow:


Drive requirements to improve batch tracking and monitoring capabilities for a range of stakeholders
Assist in developing monitoring and automation tools to reduce manual effort 
Contribute shifting toward a proactive, SRE-led model focused on platform stability and proactive incident prevention 
Help evolve observability and alerting strategies in collaboration with Release Quality Team 
Participate in incident post-mortems, root cause analysis and their long-term resolutions 
Maintain runbooks and documentation to standardize support workflows 


What We Value

We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.


1-4 years prior experience in similar field with Bachelor’s / in Computer Science, IT or Engineering from an accredited institution
Master's a plus 
Experience monitoring and supporting SaaS technology platform 
Familiarity with Cloud technology and terminology is a plus 
Experience using tools such as Kibana and Grafana 
Exposure to Power BI, Excel or SQL for data analysis and review is favourable 
Scripting experience with PowerShell/python is beneficial 
Proficient in writing and speaking English 
Solid skills in quantitative problem-solving, analysis, and detail-oriented work
Ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-departmental projects
Ability to work on a global team spread across multiple locations and time zones 


Benefits

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

NEXT STEPS 

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Jimena Ramirez (jirf@simcorp.com), Senior Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE? 

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.

Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.

Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.

About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.




The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote. Your normal workday will start at 9:30am Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!
